text.p: Following are penpix of leading contenders in Tuesday's Champion Hurdle at Cheltenham:

COLLIER BAY - Out to retain crown he won last year. Recorded narrow win over Relkeel at Towcester last month on much-delayed seasonal reappearance. Trainer: Jim Old Jockey: Graham Bradley Odds: 11-4 favourite Strengths: Fluent jumper, capable of lying up with the pace but equally affective if held up. Has won on varying ground from good to heavy. Weakness: Unsuited by firm ground.

LARGE ACTION - Tough and consistent nine-year-old who has twice been placed in the race. Has won all of his three races this season. Trainer: Oliver Sherwood Jockey: Jamie Osborne. Odds: 11-2 Strengths: Acts well on the course and can go on any ground. Stays two and a half miles, and jockey Osborne is riding at the peak of his form. Weakness: Could lack the finishing speed of others if race was run at a slow pace, but this is highly unlikely.

SPACE TRUCKER - Should be best of the Irish. Won warm-up race at Leopardstown in excellent style earlier this month and holds Make a Stand on Cheltenham running in November. Trainer: Jessica Harrington Jockey: John Shortt Odds: 13-2 Strengths: Form looks very solid and likely to have good ground in his favour. An improving type. Weakness: Has yet to prove himself at the very top level.

MAKE A STAND - Much improved hurdler who has won his last five races by impressive margins. Sets off in front and has proved impossible to catch in handicap company. Trainer: Martin Pipe Jockey: Tony McCoy Odds: 7-1 Strengths: Improving all the time and may run the legs off the opposition. Fluent jumper. Weaknesses: Was beaten at Cheltenham earlier in the season and track may not suit him. Not yet proven at the very highest level.

I'M SUPPOSIN - Another Irish raider. Has won his only two hurdle races to date. Trainer: Kevin Prendergast Jockey: Charlie SwanOdds: 8-1 Strengths: Very impressive in his two victories and a good performer as a Flat race horse. Weakness: Only a five-year-old and very inexperienced for a such a tough race as this.
